brief:
Jared Kushner, who serves as a top peace negotiator despite holding no official administration role, unveiled a $2.45 billion initial reconstruction plan for Gaza, Middle East Eye reported. Kushner acknowledged delays in the effort without providing further details on the scope or timeline of the proposal.

The starter package represents the first phase of what officials have characterized as a broader reconstruction initiative, though the modest sum has drawn scrutiny given Gaza's extensive infrastructure damage from ongoing conflict.

title: Kushner unveils $2.45bn starter plan for Gaza reconstruction
